Sample deliverable

What you receive, on a made-up product.

Northwind is fictional. The structure is exactly what a client gets: a four-reader check with quoted evidence, then the rewritten fields, ready to paste.

Part 1 · The audit

The “before” answers 0 of 12 questions.

Each mark is backed by a quoted sentence from the listing. A Yes you cannot quote is not a Yes.

01SecurityWhere is customer data stored? No
02SecurityWhich reports can you share? Partly
03SecurityRetention, deletion, model training? No
04ProcurementWhat is one pricing unit? No
05ProcurementWhat happens if we go over? No
06ProcurementSupport and SLA? No
07TechnicalDeployment and prerequisites? Partly
08TechnicalAWS services named? No
09TechnicalTime to first result? No
10AI searchWhat it does and for whom? Partly
11AI searchUse cases in buyer words? No
12AI searchEvidence behind the claims? No

Sample tally: 0 Yes, 3 Partly, 9 No. “Partly” here means the listing gestures at an answer without stating it, for example “Enterprise-grade security” with no report named.

Part 2 · The rewrite

Field by field, paste-ready.

Uses only facts the client supplies. Anything not supplied is left out, not guessed.

Before · title and short description

Northwind AI Platform

Northwind is the leading, most powerful AI platform that transforms how enterprises work with data.

  • Revolutionary AI-powered insights
  • Seamless integration with your stack
  • Enterprise-grade security
BEFORE12→AFTER88

After · title and short description

Northwind Data Cloud – plain-English analytics for Amazon Redshift

Lets finance and operations teams ask questions of their Amazon Redshift data in plain English and get a chart in under 10 seconds, with no SQL.

  • Connects to Amazon Redshift and PostgreSQL in about 15 minutes
  • SOC 2 Type II; data stays in your AWS region and is never used for training
  • Priced per user per month: 1 unit = 1 named user
WHAT CHANGED · SECURITY

Three questions answered with one line

Region, certification and training use are stated in the second highlight. The long description adds encryption in transit and at rest, SSO and audit logs.

WHAT CHANGED · PRICING

“Units” becomes “named users”

One named user, what it includes and how it is billed, in the price line. Procurement can now estimate a budget without emailing anyone.

WHAT CHANGED · TECHNICAL

Services named, time stated

Amazon Redshift and PostgreSQL by name. Setup in about 15 minutes. A technical evaluator can judge fit from the first screen.

WHAT CHANGED · AI SEARCH

Who it is for, and the job it does

Finance and operations teams, plain-English questions, a chart in under 10 seconds. A model summarising the listing has a sentence it can quote.

Scores come from the free audit run on both versions. The hand audit goes deeper than the automatic one. Northwind is fictional; no real company is described.
